class.name: SteamConfig
class.brief_description: Selects the Steam launch context and game lobby defaults.
class.description: Pass this resource to [method Steamworks.boot] for standalone features, or to the game's code-first configuration for Steam multiplayer. Boot reads the settings before attaching the client. Lobby discovery settings apply to a game configured for Steam multiplayer.

method.name: spacewar
method.description: Creates an invitation-only development profile for AppID 480. Supply the same 1 to 64 character group on both peers. Groups allow ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. A group separates discovery and join for games sharing the development AppID. The process must already launch in the Spacewar context.

method.name: public_games
method.description: Returns an independent copy of this profile with public game discovery enabled. An existing attachment keeps its original settings.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns true for an unsigned 32-bit AppID and a valid test group when the configured AppID is 480. Other AppIDs require an empty test group.

members.member: Expected unsigned 32-bit AppID. Zero accepts the Steam launch context. Select 480 with a test group for Spacewar development.
When true, a Steam multiplayer host publishes a publicly discoverable game. The default is invitation-only. This has no effect on standalone Steam features.
Group shared by the host and guests in a Spacewar test. Set only with AppID 480 and use 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.
